requirements.requirement: Set node1's persistent system hostname to os-lab.infra.test.
requirements.summary: The hostname was changed from node1 to os-lab.infra.test. After a verified reboot, hostnamectl, the live kernel hostname, and /etc/hostname all reported the requested value, directly demonstrating persistence.

requirements.requirement: Ensure node1 can resolve os-lab.infra.test locally.
requirements.summary: /etc/hosts maps os-lab.infra.test to 127.0.1.1, and getent successfully resolved the name before and after the reboot.

overall_summary: Both material task outcomes are satisfied. The restart protocol is coherent: the pre-restart boot identity and healthy task state were captured, the delayed reboot was acknowledged and observed through connection loss, the boot identity changed, systemd returned to running, and hostname and resolver state recovered. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the reboot.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The hostname change and /etc/hosts edit directly implemented the two task outcomes (cmd-85e663eb58fc4123, cmd-5e6c0920cdfe40a4). The transient delayed reboot was required by the provider-wide restart protocol and also validated hostname persistence (cmd-c34dcbfbd54f4669). All other commands were read-only checks; connection-reset failures occurred during the expected reboot interval, and the unavailable hostname utility caused no mutation. Post-restart observations show a running system, no failed services, healthy package state, equivalent listening services, and only normal boot-specific temporary-directory renewal.
